senses.gloss: f. (דלע, cmp. דֳּלִי a. זְלוּעַ) [bottle-shaped,] gourd, a general name for cucumbers, pumpkins &c. (v. Sm. Ant. s. vv. Colocynthe a. Colocynthis).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 1:2">Kil. I, 2</cite> <he>ד׳ מצרית וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>המצרי</he>, corr. acc.) Egyptian gourd and the Bitter-gourd may be planted together (v. <cite ref="K00674"><he>כִּלְאַיִם</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 6:1">Ned. VI, 1</cite> <he>דלעת הרמוצה</he>, variously explained <cite ref="Nedarim 51a:9">ib. 51ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 1:2:5">Y. Kil. I, 27ᵃ</cite> top; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Sotah 16a:10">Sot. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>מגלחו כד׳</he> he shaves his body as smooth as a gourd; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:2:29">Y. Kidd. I, 59ᵈ</cite> top <he>כדלת</he> (corr. acc.). Pl. <he>דִּלּוּעִים</he>, <cite ref="D00821"><he>דִּלּוּעִין</he></cite>, <he>דּילּ׳</he>.
